name: blyxtorch
description: Train and evaluate dense CPU networks in Blyx. Includes native trainers, editable machine-learning projects and editor snippets.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with BlyxTorch
walkthroughs.description: Run a calibration model, then train and evaluate a print-queue classifier.

steps.title: Fit your first sensor model
steps.description:
Create a file ending in .blyx. Type bt-sensor, choose the completion and run Blyx: Run File.
[Open the project guide](https://www.blyx-lang.space/packages/blyxtorch#projects)

steps.title: Train and evaluate a classifier
steps.description:
Extract the starter and open BlyxTorch.code-workspace. Choose Terminal → Run Task → BlyxTorch: Evaluate print queue.
[Download both projects](https://github.com/Rahulchaube1/blyxtorch/releases/download/v0.2.0/blyxtorch-projects-0.2.0.zip)
